setup.wizard.title: First-time setup
setup.finish.title: All set
setup.finish.summary: You can revisit any of these settings later from Config, or reopen this wizard any time from the sidebar.
setup.finish.already_complete: Setup was already completed — finishing again just confirms it.
setup.step.identity.intro: How your station identifies itself over the air and to anyone viewing this dashboard. All fields here are required.
setup.step.transmission.intro: Whether the beacon actually transmits, and whether it sends voice audio or AX.25 packet frames. Leave transmission off while you finish setup — you can turn it on any time later from Config.
setup.step.wav-handoff.intro: How rendered audio reaches your radio. "logging" (the default) is safe to leave as-is for now — it just logs what would be sent. Switch to "spool" once svxlink-txqueue is set up to actually key the rig.
setup.step.voice.intro: The text-to-speech engine used to read bulletins aloud. The shipped default works with no extra setup — only change the voice/model fields below if you've installed a different one.
setup.step.watermark.intro: Optional — periodically transmits a short station-ID message on its own timer, independent of regular bulletin content. Leave it off if you don't need it; the voice/frame wording can be customized later from Config.
setup.step.ai.intro: Optional — has an AI provider condense each bulletin before it's queued for transmission. Ollama runs on your own machine and needs no key; OpenAI and Anthropic are cloud services and need an API key below to work.
setup.step.display.intro: How dates/times, language, and theme appear on this dashboard — purely cosmetic, doesn't affect what's transmitted.
